ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on your money and what you value. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on rest and your inner life. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on friends and plans for the future. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on your career and your goals. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on relationships and partnerships. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The Sun and Uranus are together in {S:2}: willpower and visibility, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on home and family. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.
